name.value: Lao Shan Dong Homemade Noodle House

description.value: Lao Shan Dong Homemade Noodle House is a long-established Chinese noodle restaurant (est. 1949) located in Richmond's busy Number 3 Road corridor, serving handmade Taiwanese and northern Chinese noodle soups, dry noodles, dumplings, and rice dishes. The kitchen distinguishes itself by using no MSG or preservatives, and the menu spans beef tendon broth soups, braised cold meats, and Taiwanese night-market staples like scallion pancakes and pork chops. A touring cyclist can expect a hearty, carb-rich meal well-suited to refueling mid-ride.
